# HiChina
> HiChina is a Chinese domain registration, web hosting, cloud services, and website management platform operated by Alibaba Cloud China.

HiChina primarily serves users in China with domain name services, DNS, hosting, enterprise email, SSL certificates, website building, and related cloud infrastructure offerings. Its site includes product pages, domain tools, help resources, account management, and service support.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://www.hichina.com/): Main portal for domain, hosting, cloud, and website services.
- [Domain Names](https://www.hichina.com/domain/): Product area for domain registration, transfer, and management services.
- [Cloud Hosting](https://www.hichina.com/cloud/): Cloud server and hosting product overview for websites and applications.
- [Website Building](https://www.hichina.com/web/): Website creation and site-building solutions for businesses and individuals.
- [Enterprise Mail](https://www.hichina.com/mail/): Business email hosting and enterprise mailbox services.
- [Help Center](https://help.hichina.com/): Central support site for product documentation and troubleshooting.

## Domain Services
- [Domain Registration](https://www.hichina.com/domain/): Search, register, and manage domain names across supported extensions.
- [Domain Transfer](https://www.hichina.com/domain/transfer/): Transfer existing domains into the HiChina registrar platform.
- [Domain Renewal](https://www.hichina.com/domain/renew/): Renew registered domains to maintain ownership and service continuity.
- [Domain Whois](https://whois.hichina.com/): Query domain registration information and availability-related records.
- [Domain Price List](https://www.hichina.com/domain/price/): Pricing information for domain registration, renewal, and transfer operations.
- [Premium Domains](https://www.hichina.com/domain/premium/): Marketplace or featured inventory for higher-value domain names.

## DNS and Security
- [DNS Services](https://www.hichina.com/domain/dns/): DNS hosting and domain resolution management for registered domains.
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.hichina.com/ssl/): Certificate products for HTTPS deployment and website identity protection.
- [Website Security](https://www.hichina.com/security/): Security-related offerings for protecting sites and online services.
- [Domain Protection](https://www.hichina.com/domain/protect/): Services intended to improve domain safety and ownership control.
- [Verification Center](https://check.hichina.com/): Validation and checking tools for domain or service-related verification workflows.

## Hosting and Cloud
- [Cloud Hosting](https://www.hichina.com/cloud/): Hosting and cloud infrastructure products for web workloads.
- [Virtual Hosting](https://www.hichina.com/hosting/): Shared hosting services for small websites and basic deployments.
- [Cloud Server](https://www.hichina.com/cloud/server/): Scalable server resources for application and website hosting.
- [Database Services](https://www.hichina.com/cloud/database/): Managed database-related offerings for hosted applications.
- [Storage Services](https://www.hichina.com/cloud/storage/): Cloud storage products for files, backups, and static assets.
- [Backup Services](https://www.hichina.com/cloud/backup/): Backup and recovery capabilities for hosted environments.

## Website and Business Tools
- [Website Building](https://www.hichina.com/web/): Site builder tools and packaged website creation services.
- [Template Sites](https://www.hichina.com/web/template/): Prebuilt website templates for rapid business site deployment.
- [Custom Website Services](https://www.hichina.com/web/custom/): Customized website design and implementation offerings.
- [Enterprise Mail](https://www.hichina.com/mail/): Hosted email service for organizations and professional communication.
- [Trademark Services](https://www.hichina.com/trademark/): Brand and trademark-related business service offerings.
- [Corporate Services](https://www.hichina.com/company/): Business-oriented service area for enterprise customers and operations.

## Account and Console
- [Login](https://login.hichina.com/): User sign-in entry for account and service access.
- [User Center](https://member.hichina.com/): Account dashboard for managing purchased services and settings.
- [Domain Console](https://member.hichina.com/domain/): Domain management area for DNS, renewal, and ownership tasks.
- [Order Center](https://member.hichina.com/order/): View and manage service orders, renewals, and billing records.
- [Finance Center](https://member.hichina.com/finance/): Billing, invoices, payments, and account financial management.
- [Support Tickets](https://member.hichina.com/service/): Customer service request and issue tracking area.

## Help and Support
- [Help Center](https://help.hichina.com/): Official support portal with product help and service guidance.
- [Domain Help](https://help.hichina.com/domain/): Support articles for domain registration and management tasks.
- [Hosting Help](https://help.hichina.com/hosting/): Documentation for hosting setup, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
- [Mail Help](https://help.hichina.com/mail/): Guidance for enterprise email configuration and administration.
- [Website Builder Help](https://help.hichina.com/web/): Instructions for creating and maintaining websites on the platform.
- [Contact Support](https://help.hichina.com/contact/): Customer support contact options and service channels.

## Tools and Lookup
- [Whois Lookup](https://whois.hichina.com/): Search domain registration records and related ownership information.
- [Domain Search](https://www.hichina.com/domain/): Check domain availability and begin registration workflows.
- [Price Calculator](https://www.hichina.com/domain/price/): Review domain pricing across extensions and service actions.
- [Verification Tool](https://check.hichina.com/): Perform service or ownership-related checks and validation tasks.
- [DNS Management](https://member.hichina.com/domain/): Configure domain records and resolution settings in the console.

## Policies and Legal
- [Terms of Service](https://www.hichina.com/about/terms/): Service terms governing use of HiChina products and platform.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.hichina.com/about/privacy/): Policy describing collection and handling of user information.
- [Domain Rules](https://www.hichina.com/domain/rule/): Registration and management rules for supported domain services.
- [ICP Services](https://www.hichina.com/icp/): Information and services related to ICP filing requirements in China.
- [About HiChina](https://www.hichina.com/about/): Company and platform background information.
